text:
emily_cs: FYI we got a month-end ticket from customer GreenLedger — their dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens for Feb but invoice line items show 1.8M and they were bumped to higher plan tier. Customer says they didn't change usage patterns. Can anyone take this?
raj_support: On it. Do we have the invoice id and the dashboard export?
emily_cs: Invoice ID INV-2026-02-8873, attached CSV export from dashboard (link to S3) and the customer's billing export they uploaded. They highlighted the "api.tokens" line and a separate "reserved_capacity" charge that seems off.
mike_billing: Looking. First glance: invoice has a separate line "reserved:burst" for 600k tokens which the dashboard shouldn't show as consumption. Could be a metering rule applied during month-end.
aurora_prod: Tagging billing-bot to check ingestion pipeline. billing-bot: Received request INV-2026-02-8873 — running metering trace for customer_id=gl-482. ETA ~2m
billing-bot: Trace complete. Highlight: between 2026-02-28T23:58:00Z and 2026-03-01T00:02:00Z there were ~560k tokens attributed via the "burst-reserve" lens.
emily_cs: That window matches the customer's reported spike time (they did a big backfill job). They claim they ran it against dedicated but with routing set to hosted fallback for a subset.
raj_support: If requests were routed to a fallback model or duplicate receipts happened, counts could double. Need to repro: can we pull request ids for that timeframe?
mike_billing: Query I ran: 
```
SELECT request_id, route, tokens, processed_by, timestamp
FROM metering.events
WHERE customer_id='gl-482' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-02-28T23:55:00Z' AND '2026-03-01T00:05:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```
Results show many requests with identical request_id and tokens but different processed_by nodes. Looks like retry/dedup didn't trigger because of missing idempotency key on some requests.
aurora_prod: That matches a recent change — we deployed a small routing patch on 2026-02-28 23:50 that changed how we forward headers for Dedicated->Hosted fallbacks; header "X-Request-Id" was accidentally renamed to "X-Req-Id" in the forwarded request, so dedup rules (which check "X-Request-Id") missed them.
raj_support: Oof. So ticket: duplicated ingestion due to header rename when fallback happened. That could create the +600k tokens on invoice but dashboard (which queries primary metering table before dedup reconciliation) might show only the reconciled figure.
mike_billing: Correct — invoicing pipeline reads raw metering events and applies post-process dedup window daily; invoice generator used the raw pre-dedup snapshot for that billing run due to batch job race (we regenerated invoice lines but cutoff was earlier).
emily_cs: What's the customer-facing remediation and timeline?
aurora_prod: We rolled back the header change at 2026-03-01 01:12, and kicked a re-ingest/cleanup job to mark duplicates and re-run reconciliation. Should finish within 4 hours.
mike_billing: I'll open a billing adjustment once reconciliation completes. If duplicates are removed, invoice should drop ~600k tokens and reserve line removed.
raj_support: For the customer response: explain cause (routing header rename -> duplicate attribution), timeline for corrected invoice, and offer a one-time credit if they were impacted by tier bump in the meantime. Include repro notes and mitigation steps.
emily_cs: Draft reply: "Thanks — we traced an internal routing change that caused duplicate metering events for your backfill window. We're reconciling and will issue a corrected invoice within 24h. As an apology we've applied a one-time credit to offset any tier bump charges — you should see it on the corrected invoice." Thoughts?
mike_billing: Fine. Please avoid promising exact amounts until reconciliation finishes.
raj_support: Also include steps they can take to ensure idempotency: set X-Request-Id on all client retries and avoid client-side replays during scheduled backfills.
aurora_prod: Internal action items: 1) Postmortem draft, 2) Add integration test for header forwarding, 3) Add an alert for invoice-generator using pre-dedup snapshot.
billing-bot: Noted and created tasks: TASK-2394 (billing reconciliation), TASK-2395 (routing header tests), TASK-2396 (invoice-generator alert).
emily_cs: I'll send customer the message and CC billing. Will update the thread with customer reply.
raj_support: Thanks team. If the invoice correction is delayed >24h ping me.
billing-bot: Invoice correction job finished at 1795001450. Duplicate markers applied, corrected invoice pushed (INV-2026-02-8873-CORR).
mike_billing: Confirmed corrected invoice removes reserved burst line and tokens now match dashboard (1.21M). I'll apply the one-time credit to cover any residual tier threshold impact.
emily_cs: Customer updated: "Thanks for the fast fix — we confirm the corrected invoice and appreciate the credit." Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
